title.narrative: Rehabilitation of the Streetlights System and the Electric Grid in Janjevë / Janjevo

description.narrative: The overall development challenge in Janjevë/Janjevo, Kosovo , is multifaceted, encompassing outdated public infrastructure, particularly streetlights, and electrical grid systems. These issues pose significant risks to public health, safety, and economic stability, particularly affecting the Croat community residing in the Historic Centre. The lack of reliable infrastructure hampers daily life exacerbates health hazards, and impedes economic development, necessitating urgent intervention. Expected results of the project encompass multifaceted outcomes: infrastructure upgrades such as streetlights and electrical grids to ensure reliability, efficiency, and adherence to modern standards; enhanced public safety and security through improved street lighting and stable power supply, thereby reducing crime rates and accidents, particularly benefiting vulnerable groups; economic empowerment facilitated by infrastructure improvements, fostering entrepreneurship, attracting tourists, and promoting local businesses, thereby reducing poverty and inequality; cultural heritage preservation through the protection and revitalization of historic sites and the Historic Centre, enhancing aesthetic appeal, attracting tourists, and contributing to the local economy while ensuring the conservation of cultural heritage for future generations; and urban development and liveability enhancements, where upgraded infrastructure enhances Janjevë/Janjevos liveability, attracting residents and businesses, revitalizing the community, and contributing to sustainable urban development.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
